Hon'ble Narendra Kumar Johari,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned A.G.A. for the State/respondent Nos.1 to 3 as well as learned counsel for the private respondent and perused the record.

By means of this writ petition, the petitioners have sought quashing of the First Information Report dated 07.05.2024, registered as Case Crime/F.I.R. No.0431/2024, under Sections 498-A, 323, 504,
506, 307 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, registered at Police Station - Kotwali,
District - Barabanki.

sentences.text:
Heard learned counsel for petitioners, learned A.G.A. for the State and Sri Vinay Kumar Dubey, learned counsel for opposite party no.4.
2.

This petition seeks issuance of a writ for quashing the F.I.R. dated 7.5.2024 bearing Case Crime No.0431 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 & 307 I.P.C. and Sections 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Kotwali, District Barabanki.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioners has drawn the attention of this Court towards Annexure-SA-1 to the supplementary affidavit, which is an original compromise deed entered into between the petitioners and opposite party no.4.
4. Learned counsel for both the parties state that parties have entered into a compromise and they are not willing to contest the case against each other.
5. So as to verify the contents and parties of the compromise deed, let the original deed of compromise be sent to the Senior Registrar of this Court.
On 1.6.2024 parties shall appear before the Senior Registrar for the purpose of verification of compromise deed as well as parties.
6. The Senior Registrar of this Court after due verification shall submit his report before this Court.

7. List this case on 5.6.2024.
8.
Interim order, if any, granted earlier shall continue till the next date of listing."
The Report of Senior Registrar dated 06.07.2024 is on record, according to which, the parties have settled their dispute amicably by way of compromise.

According to the terms of the compromise,
which is enclosed with the supplementary affidavit dated 17.05.2024, the F.I.R. was got registered on account of confusing circumstances.

However, in the meantime, both the parties have reached an amicable settlement and they do not want to pursue the proceedings any further and that the aforesaid F.I.R. assailed in the instant writ petition may be quashed.
Learned counsel for the opposite party no.4 did not dispute to the same rather, he has stated that the parties have settled their dispute and the opposite party no.4 has no grievance.

As the parties have settled their dispute amicably, we see no reason to allow the investigation to proceed in pursuance to the impugned F.I.R. We, accordingly, quash the impugned First Information Report dated 07.05.2024, registered as Case Crime/F.I.R. No.0431/2024, under Sections 498-A, 323, 504, 506, 307 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, registered at Police Station - Kotwali, District - Barabanki, and all proceedings/investigation which may have been held consequent thereto are also quashed and the writ petition is allowed.
